full_judgment: 2. The plaint case is that Sheikh Emdad Box took settlement of the suit property by executing a kabuliyat in favour of the Deity and the same was recorded in his name. Thereafter he surrendered the tenancy in favour of the plaintiff-Deity by a registered deed on 27.11.40 and handed over vacant possession to the plaintiff. One Shoyeb Ahmed Sarker migrated to this country in 1952 and approached the then Shebayet to live in the suit land and accordingly he was allowed to live as a licensee. The defendants having not vacated the suit property in spite of the demand for the vacant possession the suit was filed.
